translations.text: The elder to the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I alone but also all who have come to know the truth,
because of the truth, which dwells among us and will be with us forever.
Grace, mercy and peace be with you from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, his Son, in truth and love.
I rejoiced greatly, for I found some of your children walking in truth, just as we received the commandment from the Father.
And now I ask you, lady, not as though I were writing you a new commandment, but the one that I have had from the beginning: that we love one another.
And this is love: that we walk according to his commandments. And this is his commandment, just as you heard from the beginning: that you should walk in it.
For many deceivers have gone out into the world, who do not confess Jesus Christ as having come in the flesh. Such a one is the deceiver and the antichrist.
Watch yourselves, so that we do not lose what we have worked for, but receive the reward in full.
Everyone who goes too far and does not remain in the teaching of Christ does not have God with him; but whoever remains in the teaching of Christ has both the Son and the Father with him.
If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your houses and do not say "Rejoice" to him as a greeting.
For whoever says "Rejoice" to him shares in his evil deeds.
I have much to write to you, but I did not want to do it with paper and ink, for I hope to come to you and speak face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
The children of your elect sister greet you.
